notes.title: Update 2.0.3
notes.content:
The new Overtime chapter is here! It's new full-length chapter that continues the story of Penny and her friends!

Update 2.0.3

 Removes the hard cap for logs collected in Lumber Lass Fever
- This is implemented by way of a "prestige" system.
- When the big number that was the old cap is reached, all logs collected will be consumed to increment a "star" level. This repeats if/when the big number is reached again.
- Nothing else happens, but at least the numbers will continue to go up.
- You really don't have to try it for yourself. There's no achievement for it.
Fixes for typos, formatting errors, and small bugs
(Just FYI) Where's 2.0.2? We skipped it on Steam because it only had bug fixes for a non-Steam build

Anyway, thanks for playing and for all your love and support!!

notes.title: Overtime!
notes.content:
First, thank you to everyone who has already bought and loved Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines. This new update is for you. Really, I can't thank you enough.

It took a while, but it's done! A whole new extra bonus chapter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/fc9f971fd9bf5d44a3e03df66bae2ad18b3509fd.png

And it's available now, for everyone who already owns Dreams and Deadlines! For free! Update the game, and you should see the new "Overtime" chapter on the title screen. The story takes place a year after the "True Ending" of Dreams and Deadlines, and if the game can't detect whether you've already seen it (achievement: "A Bright Future?"), it'll warn you that you should probably do that first, but it also won't stop you if you want to play the new chapter anyway. 

New Stuff in the Overtime Update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/a577cf9690f8d6a1fbbf0d63fbc42d276a16dfdf.png
 An entirely new full-length chapter, continuing Penny's story after the events of Dreams and Deadlines! It's like, longer than the original game! It basically doubles the total game size! A real bonus, as they say.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/164c7c3d4615a672152bceb97c03c51c31cce06b.png
 More CG artworks than the original game. I drew a lot of new pictures! Ow, my hand hurts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/8a62db381f6131d1c56aca2dd01c83cb0c46d9d1.png
 26 new achievements! Behold the consequences of your actions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/432c99358cd414edf07b6347a7b371f81adbecbf.png
 A new achievement gallery! Keep track of all the achievements you've unlocked, each with a cool piece of artwork.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/bb40046cbe84cc135d08072e1c79086eca403c92.png
 Lumber Lass Fever! It's Lumber Lass, but with a "Fever" button!

 And of course, more music from the amazing and illustrious Chance Thrash.

And so on. Anyway, I really hope you enjoy the new chapter as much as I enjoyed making it. If you find any weird bugs or issues, please feel free to post in the bug report forum or email me at my support address. And if you enjoy the new chapter and want more, please follow my dev page on Steam or my social medias so you can stay tuned for whatever's next in the Endless Monday Video Game Universe. Thank you again!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/073d3d423e3bac77c66c1b4156b71472a731d119.png

notes.title: Happy New Year 2025!! And Some Announcements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/81a4ba53a9dc5d59235176e8a4b97eb6019c971b.png

Well, another year has passed, and it's 2025 now. Hope you had a good year. I've been busy!

We released Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines in three more languages. I'm happy the game has been so loved around the world.

You might remember that I said I was hoping to release a free content update in 2024, but after working hard on it for most of the year (with lots of other responsibilities throughout), it turns out it would take just a little longer... 

Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines and Overtime

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/0bdc33e1c9809fe6fc54391a60b4701516f43c86.png
But... I'm happy to announce it's almost done! Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines and Overtime is the next chapter of Penny's story, and will be available for free to everyone who already owns a copy of the game. All the text is written and is now undergoing localization for all currently supported languages, while I finish up the remaining art assets and code (and there are a lot of new art assets I need to draw.). I'm expecting the update to be ready for release in February. Or thereabouts. Okay, definitely sometime in March, though.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/40c9b13637a3e0425297d8b7ce2405662e74de99.png
The story continues one year after the events of Dreams and Deadlines, and is about the same length as the first chapter (wow!). If you haven't gotten the (true) ending yet, you'll probably want to get that before playing the new chapter. And of course, there will be new features like a bonus gallery and new achievements (20+ more)! I'll avoid talking much more about it so as to avoid ~Spoilers~. But I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I did making it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/164c7c3d4615a672152bceb97c03c51c31cce06b.png
So yeah! Please look forward to the continued adventures of Penny and her friends, back at the office. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/a577cf9690f8d6a1fbbf0d63fbc42d276a16dfdf.png 
Or not.

Other stuff

After the Overtime Update, I'm going to start diving deep into Game 2! That's right! The second game. I need to make more game to sell so I can keep making more game, after all. As they say. So, expect to see some updates about that in 2025, too. 

And of course, here's a link to Chance Thrash's luxurious OST for the game. Chance has also graciously provided some great new tracks for the Overtime Update.

Thank you playing, and I hope you stick around for more adventures in the Endless Monday Video Game Universe! And I hope you have a wonderful 2025!!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/dd9dd3885956f7f01a670e768a3ca4c9a85522c1.png

notes.title: Trading Cards and Other Updates
notes.content:
Hello again! Thank you for playing Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines! I have a few updates for you this fine Thursday afternoon.

Trading cards

Profile stuff is now live! You can now collect trading cards and turn them into badges and get profile backgrounds and emoticons. I put Skye and Penny on my own profile! Ain't that something? From what they're telling me you will receive cards retroactively for the playtime you've already put in to the game, so a lot of you should already see some cards in your inventory...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/cd94dd4ff11c706a3fd76df5ae773db7d453697d.png
Above: Trading cards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/dbb6a65a5770f4f80e779d2b476a3653dade1748.png
Above: Your profile will probably be less empty than my test profile! But just look at Skye and Penny!


I think it's pretty cool. I hope you like it too. 

Other Stuff

In addition to making profile backgrounds and emoticons, I've been hard at work trying to get a Mac build ready for release. It's mostly done, but I'm working through a few bugs that should be squashed soon. I'm also adding a windowed fullscreen mode (whoa). Both of these involved a bit of under-the-hood changes to the game code, so I'm also testing that there aren't any issues as a result of that on the other OSes. This is probably of interest to a few of you, anyway. But still... all of this will be worth it for future works, which I'm already brainstorming.

I've made good progress on the localization framework for the game. I'm kind of building it around an upcoming Japanese localization, which is coming along nicely, and after that I'll explore other languages.

The Official Game Soundtrack is now on Spotify in addition to Bandcamp! Support our super cool composer Chance Thrash by checking these out.

There are some new Dreams and Deadlines stickers on my merch shop! After putting some Endless Monday on your Steam profile, why not put a bit of Endless Monday on your real life stuff? You know you want the "Lumber Lass" and "Log Wild" stickers...

Anyway, I think that's it for now. Thanks for your continued love and support!

notes.title: Thank You!!! And What's Next
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474029/dd9dd3885956f7f01a670e768a3ca4c9a85522c1.png
It's been roughly four days since ENDLESS MONDAY: DREAMS AND DEADLINES release! Whoa, has it really been four days already? I'm pretty sure the launch and response from players has wildly exceeded all my expectations in every way possible, but I'm too tired right now to fully grasp the situation or properly appreciate the magnitude of what's happened. Thank you so much for loving the game! Really! Thank you!! 

Before we get started: The OST is out!! You can check it out here, on Chance Thrash's bandcamp page. Please support the amazing composer of the game's OST. I'll wait!

I (still) haven't been able to get much sleep because I've been busy with the post-launch bug fixes and support and social media posts and stuff. But with today's hotfix out (which I'm hoping should be the last one as far as high priority fixes go), I'm going to try to get some rest for once.

Okay, so, I'm sure you want to know what's next. No? Well I'm telling you anyway.

1. Community Items: Steam graciously enabled Profile Features for the game, meaning you can now add the game to your profile's various showcases, like for showing off cool achievement icons or your favorite games. This also enabled the Steam "Community Items" (Trading cards and point shop items, etc). So I'm going to work on that and hopefully have them submitted by this week! Please wait warmly!

2. Mac support: This was planned for release but I didn't have time to finish this before the deadline, so I focused on Windows and SteamDeck instead. But I'll try to get this out as soon as I can, so that Mac gamers and people who want to game on their work laptops can play. Coming soon, hopefully!

3. Localization tooling: I didn't build in good support for localization because I was too focused on just getting the game out. I figured I'd worry about it when the time came. Well, the time has come... Unsure when this will be done, but after that I can start thinking about non-English translations for the game.

4. Content Updates:  I've been kicking around a lot of ideas in my head for free content updates in the form of short side-stories that take place apart from the game's storyline and other vignettes or minigames. You might see these every once in a while in the coming months. I'm not expecting them to go on forever though, because at some point I'll have to look to the future...

5. Future:  I really want to make more games. I would love the opportunity to make another game, and make this a series and explore more stories in the Endless Monday Video Game Universe. Or just do something completely different. Well it's a little early to be dreaming about this right now, but... anyway...

Also! If you want to support me beyond buying my game (which honestly is already support enough), and you want to put stickers of Tiger-chan or Penny or any of the others on your stuff, I have a merch shop on my website at endlessmonday.com. You can also sign up for a newsletter there too. Or visit my other social media pages. Or whatever.

That's all I have for now. Thanks again, for all your love and support. I'm hoping this is just the beginning! Okay, see you in the next update!
